title: When Bad Things Happen To Good People

questions.q: What personal tragedy did Rabbi Kushner experience?
a: His son died of a disease
He lost his home in a fire
questions.why: He recounts his son Aaron died at 14 from an incurable disease.

questions.q: Why does Kushner say God cannot always prevent suffering?
questions.why: He explains God cannot step in to bend nature's laws to protect individuals.

questions.q: What common phrase does the author say can hurt people in pain?
questions.why: He notes bystanders often say "everything happens for a reason," which can be painful.

questions.q: According to Kushner, what should people focus on when someone suffers?
questions.why: He argues the meaning of pain comes from how we respond, emphasizing support.

questions.q: What does the book claim about the link between deservingness and outcomes?
questions.why: He states accepting that outcomes aren't tied to deservingness is realistic.
